title: http.registry.contract.reject.v1.response
description: The contract registration after the reject transition, projected from the kernel ContractRegistration (state advanced to 'rejected', a terminal state that is never activatable).

state.description: Lifecycle state; the sealed RegistrationState wire spelling (after reject: 'rejected').

submitter.description: Authenticated principal subject that submitted the registration.

approver.description: Authenticated admin subject that approved the registration; absent for a rejected registration unless previously approved.
